findings.quoted_text: Contractor's liability arising from this Agreement is not subject to any cap or limit.
Contractor's liability arising from this Agreement is not subject to any cap or limit.
findings.explanation: Your liability under this agreement is completely unlimited, exposing you to potentially catastrophic financial losses if a claim is brought against you.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of each party arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be capped at the total fees paid by the Client to the Contractor under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose an adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning liability, it currently leaves liability completely unlimited; I propose modifying this so that the aggregate liability of each party arising from the agreement is capped at the total fees paid by the client to the contractor under the agreement. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
